rows.en: He punched right through the wall with his bare hands...!!
All right!! We're getting out of here!!
The heroes broke through the ice wall.
Looks like we made it out somehow...
Hey, God Gundam. That Grand Gundam guy's gonna come after us again, right?
He said something about the Devil Gundam's Four Heavenly Kings. So there are four of those things...
...Yes. But Heaven's Sword has already been defeated.
That leaves three: Master Gundam, Grand Gundam, and Walter Gundam.
Ankh, what's gotten into you all of a sudden?
I've been acting alone until now, but to take on this many kaijin, and even kaiju,
I've started to feel the limits of fighting by myself.
Why don't you come with us, God Gundam? I'll admit you're strong. But from here on...
From here on, I'll be coming along with you.
I knew it! Of course you would! Then...
Glad to have you with us.
So you showed up after all, Grand Gundam!! Did Master Gundam send you!?
There you are, Grand Gundam!! Did Master Gundam send you!?
There you are, Grand Gundam!! Did Master Gundam send you!?
There you are, Grand Gundam!! Did Master Gundam send you!?
There you are, Grand Gundam!! Did Master Gundam send you!?
So you showed up after all, Grand Gundam!!
So you showed up after all, Grand Gundam!!
Whoa, I knew you'd show up!! Grand Gundam!!
Knew you'd show up. I saw right through you, Grand Gundam!!
I knew it... It's Grand Gundam!
So you've come after all, Grand Gundam!!
So you've come after all, Grand Gundam!!
So you showed up after all, Grand Gundam!!
Figures you'd show your face! Grand Gundam!!
Of course!! I can't let you lot get past me!!
Now then, time is almost up! The teams who have reached this venue so far are...
And Walter Gundam. Seven teams in all!
Oh ho, less than one minute remains!?
(Heh... So the heroes never showed up in the end. It seems Grand Gundam did his job well.)
The remaining time ticked steadily away...
And then came the fateful countdown!

notes.note: Slice speaker labels after the empty entry #0.86 are off by one. 0441.bla maps MessWinSet TextIdOffset+n to row n+1 throughout (checked against #0.22-0.27 and #0.70-0.90): #0.104 Ankh, #0.105 God Gundam, #0.107 narration, #0.111 Ankh, #0.112-0.113 God Gundam, #0.115 Ankh, #0.116-0.117 and #0.119 God Gundam. #0.91-0.103 are the 13 leader variants of 'The wall...!!' (identical JP, identical EN).

#0.108-0.110, #0.114, #0.118 and #0.120-0.122 are not referenced by 0441.bla (apparently an unused draft of the recruitment talk). Speakers inferred: #0.109 a rough party member (Ankh-like) to God Gundam, #0.110 God Gundam, #0.114 someone reacting to Ankh, #0.118 probably Ankh inviting God Gundam, #0.121 God Gundam accepting. The script's last Ankh line (TextIdOffset+123, i.e. #0.124) does not exist in the table.
Sentence runs into #0.117; English cut at the matching comma. 'Kaijin' per glossary (revived kaijin); kaiju for kaijuu.
Unreferenced row; speaker unknown. Direction taken as party -> God Gundam (a welcome). If God Gundam says it, 'I'm counting on you all.' would fit instead.
Source ends with a full stop; '!' matches the established 'X joined the party!' lines.

0443.bla leader order (second Pt_Chara_Check chain: 8,6,7,9,10,1,2,3,4,5,11,12,14,15) = God Gundam, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00, Rider 1, RX, Den-O (Momotaros), W (Shotaro), OOO, Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero. Matches the wording (God Gundam and the Gundams ask about Master Gundam; rough forms at Momotaros/Shotaro/Zero) and the script-labelled 0444 #0.21-0.34 arrival block. Same order for #0.20-0.33.
OOO's variant; source has a trailing line break, dropped.
Grand Gundam. Long-dash shout rendered as a stretched 'hell'.
Rows #0.5-0.7 are absent from the table; the list in #0.2-0.4 plus Walter Gundam makes seven teams.
Master Gundam's thought; archaic 'arawarenanda' = did not appear. Parentheses kept as in source.

#0.21-0.29 (and story_082 #0.30-0.34) are per-hero arrival shouts, labels from the script: God Gundam, Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero, 00, Rider 1, RX, Den-O, Shotaro. 'Kita zo' (Wing Zero/00) = arrived at the venue: 'We made it...!'.

report: 80/80 rows. Slice speaker labels in 0441 after #0.86 are shifted by one; corrected from 0441.bla (row = TextIdOffset+n+1). Eight 0441 rows (#0.108-0.110, #0.114, #0.118, #0.120-0.122) are unreferenced by the script; speakers inferred, #0.122 direction uncertain. 0443 leader order from Pt_Chara_Check. No names outside the glossary.
